content.comment_body: Hello, Is it possible to establish a network connection between two [product_name] modules of type [article_no]? I noticed that in [product_name] Soft Comfort, it appears possible with certain modules. Appreciate any advice.

I've worked with two of these [product_name] modules, but they don't communicate directly with each other. The programming seems correct, and I've uploaded the required configuration to both units. They're connected using Ethernet. Individually, I can access each module online and control its inputs and outputs, but the network-level inputs and outputs are unresponsive. It functions properly in simulation mode. After troubleshooting the hardware, I suspect the issue is with the program or compatibility. When attempting to add devices in the software, I don’t see this particular [product_name] ([article_no]) listed for network connection. Options for other versions show up, but not [article_no].
The [product_name] with order number [article_no] is actually a [product_name] [version_no]. For more details about the [version_no] history, please refer to the attached file.

To update, the reason the two [product_name] modules weren't communicating was that the S7 option wasn't selected in the configuration software. Once enabled, communication worked as expected. Thanks for the help!

analysis.insight_summary: The user encountered difficulties connecting two [product_name] modules ([article_no] version) for network communication, with successful simulation but real device connection issues. The main obstacle was not finding the correct device version in [product_name] Soft Comfort and compatibility confusion. Ultimately, the problem was due to a software setting (S7 tab not enabled), which once corrected, allowed the modules to communicate as intended.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects clear compatibility and visibility of their [product_name] model within the configuration software, enabling straightforward network setup and successful device communication following correct configuration.
